name: MetalGreymon (X Antibody)
main_effect: [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon can't have its DP reduced by your opponent's effects, and isn't affected by ＜De-Digivolve＞ effects. Then, if [MetalGreymon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less.
source_effect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a Digimon becomes unsuspended, if this Digimon has [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
